Internal distribution system

One research object. Every channel.

Recipes preserve the canonical blog post and source references while producing the operational package required for YouTube, Shorts, X and Instagram. Publishing adapters remain separate credentialed boundaries.

RECIPE CONTRACT
Source of truthBlog + data
Video outputManifest + script
Social outputStructured copy
UploadAdapter boundary
No fake “published” result: YouTube upload requires a real OAuth publisher implementation.
